blurb: A one-line doc is `--- text`. The older `--|` spelling is refused rather than reread, so no file written for it changes meaning unnoticed. The fix is machine-applicable: `bynk check --fix` applies it and `bynk fmt` rewrites a whole project. A `--|` with no text has no one-line form; write a doc block between two `---` lines.
summary: A `--|` one-line doc, the spelling before #2203; a one-line doc is `--- text` (auto-fixable; `bynk fmt` rewrites it).
